text: The report recommends delegation of approval of terms and conditions for Energy Savings Performance Agreements (ESPA) under the previously-approved financing for Efficiency Capital to Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Direct Investment Committee. This ‘housekeeping’ change mirrors the original delegation to the Investment Committee as the newly-established Direct Investment Committee did not exist at the time.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Deferred the consideration of the item until the next meeting of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
